}}'''Mordaine''' was a [[Jenn Aiel]] woman who lived during the construction of [[Rhuidean]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Mordaine}}

==Appearance==
Mordaine had graying hair and deep-set green eyes.{{ref/book|4|25}}

==History==
Mordaine, along with [[Dermon]] and [[Narisse]], speak for the Jenn Aiel. They allow the [[Aiel]] to send their sept chiefs and [[Wise Ones]] to [[Rhuidean]]. They do this to preserve ''[[ji'e'toh]]'' and the [[Prophecy of Rhuidean]].{{ref/book|4|25}}
